theme_label_cn: 桃粉主题 · 扇 · 桃梦花境·牵缘人
age_phrase: a slender young woman, likely in {p} late teens
watermark: peach blossoms, pink butterflies and trailing vines
gradient: pale cherry pink at the top to a deeper rose pink lower down
moon_halo: a hazy pink moon ringed by a soft rose halo
backdrop: silhouetted mountain ridges and a small tiered Chinese pavilion standing behind the figure
hair_ornaments: small peach blossoms and silver butterfly pins
robe_gradient: cherry pink at the chest to saturated rose pink at the trailing hem
hold_action: {V:hold} a peach-blossom jade fan "绯梦" raised before {p} lips
weapon_charm: a pink crystal peach-blossom charm hanging from its handle
expr_desc_1: {p} eyelids sit heavy and half lowered with the pupils showing beneath them, and the corners of {p} mouth curve up into a soft lazy smile
expr_desc_2: {p} head is upright but {p} lids are lowered until {p} gaze rests down and away and {p} eyes are barely open, {p} lips closed and relaxed
expr_desc_3: {p} head tips a little back, {p} lids sit low and glossy, {p} lips part loosely and colour rises on both cheeks
expr_desc_4: {p} head turns three-quarters away from the reader and {p} chin lifts, while {p} eyes turn back toward the reader over {p} shoulder
profile: 性格：娇懒浪漫，天真执着
喜好：收情书、酿桃花蜜、放河灯、雨中折花
couplet: 我本无心，只因你入梦，便留了心。
weapon_drawing: a small drawing of the peach-blossom jade fan
background_text: 桃夭，桃梦花境的牵缘人。{T}以扇引蝶，以花为舟，渡人入情，却从不入他人的梦。看似娇懒浪漫、游戏人间，实则清醒孤绝，只肯在月下独酌。{T}在花境中种满桃树，引万千粉蝶为伴，唯独等一个从不入梦的人。扇声起时，粉蝶覆月；扇声落处，梦醒无痕。
signature: —— 一扇一蝶一浮生，梦里不知身是客。
lighting: the pink moon behind thin cloud
palette: moon white, cherry pink and rose pink
